description:
Activate Celestial Unicorn by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Celestial Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Celestial Unicorn
uses.cardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink
